reviews.comment: She's a pretty good lecturer. She's always open to answering questions if you get stuck on HW. You get 3 tries per Q, pls try to understand them properly. Her exams are similar in format to them. If you actually understand the HW, there's no way you can't do well in this class. The final is optional. Labs might get tedious but they are spaced out.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit and optional final. Amazing professor.
Fantastic professor, helped me a lot with rescheduling exams at the end of the year when my health went wonky. 10/10 would recommend for ECEN 214.

i liked her, she always responded to emails, even when they were in the middle of the night. she seems like she cared about her students alot, when the first exam was too hard she asked for feedback and made the second one much easier. overall though i thought the exams were pretty fair and not that hard if you did the homeworks.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is pretty straightforward. Lectures are definitely boring, which makes the attendance quizzes annoying. But the exams are very similar if not the same as the homework problems. There are 3 exams with an optional final which drops lowest. Lots of circuits. Use online resources and Chat to learn the concepts you don't. Not too hard.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She gives a ton of homework in her course but her exams arent insanely difficult and are typically very close the previous/practice exams she posts. pretty helpful during office hours too. continue showing up for her lectures or she will get irritated and start giving mandatory attendance quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was a good professor overall. Her lectures made sense, and the homework was very similar to the exams, so if you actually do and study the homework, you'll be good. She gives review questions before exams and explains things well in class. Just be aware that she's strict about deadlines and does not typically give homework extensions.

Very respectable professor. Lectures are not perfect but cover the general ideas and some problems. Very often there will be "quizzes" in which you must submit a problem covered in the lecture to Canvas due by the end of class. Textbook is a fantastic resource. Study outside of class, do lots of supplemental problems, and you'll get an A easily.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: To be fair she's nice as a person and accessible in office hours. Lecturers are very boring i was fighting to not fall asleep & they did not prepare well for the exams. She walk you through few problems in class but doesn't focus on the general conceptional aspect. 214 is doable, if you must have her u can survive with self study and focus on HWs!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a pretty good prof, she's reasonable and shows that she cares. If there was a 3.5 I would rate her that. Lectures were pretty boring most of the time and there were also in-class quizzes. There's a lot of HW but it prepares you for the exams. They're a lot easier than the hws and it's pretty easy to score high with generous partial credit.
The homework assignments were way too long but they made you prepared for the exam. Exams were fair and doable. Easy class, professor taught adequately. Lectures are kinda boring, just push through.

Her lectures are not the greatest but are okay. Weekly homeworks in cengage. Exams rely heavily on homework concepts so study very well the homework for the exams and she also gives extra credit for exams. Labs are tough but doable, TAs are very helpful.

Her lectures convinced me to stop taking melatonin gummies and go to her lectures instead. They are super dry and teaches straight out of the textbook. Forced students to buy a $100 Cengage textbook or else you can't do the HW (textbook is literally free as an online pdf). Fair exams and HW, and offers extra credit on exams.

Exams are fair and she gives a lot of partial credit for problems plus some occasional extra credit opportunities for the first few exams. HWs can take you 5 hrs a week but ensures you learn the material. Lectures are OK but gets the points across.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor presents significant challenges in the classroom, which may dampen enthusiasm for the subject. The lectures can be difficult to follow, potentially impacting students' success negatively. If possible, consider enrolling in this class in a different semester or with another instructor.

Nice person, but bad professor.
Expect extremely long assignments, with little in explanation, and many typos. 
Grades are haphazard, be prepared to be screwed over by extremely late grading (got all grades in canvas last day of finals)
The lecture is boring, and helps little in actual assignments.
Don't take this professor, if you can avoid her.

The professor did a decent job at conducting the course despite not having taught in years, although lectures were often confused and deviations from the syllabus were unfortunately common. Generous extra credit was provided through in-class quizzes for low exam averages, so it was not too difficult to do well despite the difficulty of the content.

For reference I am a student who took university 207 and made a raw A. This is her first year teaching, and she is incredibly inexperienced. All the homework was on Pearson, and she could not help me with a single problem. The curve favored lower achieving students, so if you want a 4.0 do not pray on the curve, only C - kids will benefit most.

The only professor capable of taking a student passionate about a subject and making them hate it. The worst class I have ever taken, hands down. Incoherent lectures, deviates from syllabus often, randomly changes rules for exams, absurd amounts of homework, intentionally trying to fail people. If this is your only choice, wait a semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework
